title: A member cannot skip a host's RSVP approval queue by re-inserting their RSVP as already admitted

source.ref: Meta scan eight (2026-10-12), regression review of #3143 (SCAN-696).

detail: FILED 2026-10-12. THE CONSEQUENCE: guard_event_rsvp_member_write allows approval_status 'none' or 'pending' on any member INSERT whatever the event, and the insert policy (20270303000000_guest_rsvp_seats.sql) checks only that the row is the caller's own. Every reader treats not-pending as admitted (lib/events/admission.ts isAdmitted, the capacity and going counts, the hidden-venue disclosure). A member deletes their pending row (delete-own is allowed) and re-inserts it with 'none', and the same works after a host's decline, which deletes the row; the app's booking-window checks are skipped too. THE FIX: a migration so the guard, on a caller-role INSERT, reads events.rsvp_requires_approval and requires approval_status = 'pending' when it is true, with a pgTAP case.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=(p)=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';if(!fs.readdirSync('supabase/migrations').some(f=>f>'20270345011900'&&/guard_event_rsvp_member_write/.test(r('supabase/migrations/'+f))&&/rsvp_requires_approval/.test(r('supabase/migrations/'+f)))){console.error('SCAN-844: a member can insert an admitted RSVP on an approval-gated event');process.exit(1)}"
